stem: The masses, in kilograms, of large sacks of flour and small sacks of flour have the independent distributions $\text{N}(40, 1.5^2)$ and $\text{N}(12, 0.7^2)$ respectively.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Find the probability that the total mass of 6 randomly chosen large sacks of flour is more than 245 kg.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Find the probability that the mass of a randomly chosen large sack of flour is less than 4 times the mass of a randomly chosen small sack of flour.
